metadata.question: Was the percentage of cloud cover over Lago Hermoso, Argentina higher on March 29, 1987 (morning) compared to February 15, 2001?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Need to find satellite imagery over Lago Hermoso, Argentina for two dates: * March 29, 1987 (morning) * February 15, 2001 - Landsat 5 TM was active in 1987 (launched 1984) - Landsat 7 ETM+ was active in 2001 (launched 1999) - Define Lago Hermoso location in Argentina (approximately -38.5, -69.5 in Patagonia region) 2. Masking strategy: - This question asks about cloud cover percentage directly, so I should NOT mask clouds - Instead, I need to calculate the cloud percentage for each image - Use QA_PIXEL band (Landsat Collection 2) or cloud detection from TOA reflectance - For older Landsat, use BQA or calculate cloud detection from spectral indices 3. Logic: - Extract one image per date - Calculate cloud percentage using available cloud quality flags - Compare: if 1987 > 2001, answer A; otherwise B - Handle cases: C1 if no images found, C2 if no valid pixels, C3 if calculation fails ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define Lago Hermoso, Argentina (approximately -38.5, -69.5) const lagoHermoso = ee.Geometry.Point([-69.5, -38.5]).buffer(5000); // Date 1: March 29, 1987 (morning) - Use Landsat 5 TM const date1Start = '1987-03-29'; const date1End = '1987-03-30'; // Date 2: February 15, 2001 - Use Landsat 7 ETM+ const date2Start = '2001-02-15'; const date2End = '2001-02-16'; // Attempt Landsat 5 for 1987 let col1 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(lagoHermoso) .filterDate(date1Start, date1End) .select('QA_PIXEL'); let size1 = col1.size().getInfo(); console.log(`1987-03-29 Landsat 5: ${size1} images`); if (size1 === 0) { console.log("No Landsat 5 data for 1987. Trying Landsat 4..."); col1 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LT04/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(lagoHermoso) .filterDate(date1Start, date1End) .select('QA_PIXEL'); size1 = col1.size().getInfo(); console.log(`1987-03-29 Landsat 4: ${size1} images`); } // Landsat 7 for 2001 let col2 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LE07/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(lagoHermoso) .filterDate(date2Start, date2End) .select('QA_PIXEL'); let size2 = col2.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2001-02-15 Landsat 7: ${size2} images`); if (size1 === 0 || size2 === 0) { console.log("Empty Collection: Missing data for one or both dates"); console.log("C1"); return; } // Calculate cloud percentage for each image // QA_PIXEL bit 3 (cloud) and bit 4 (cloud shadow) const getCloudPercentage = (image) => { const qa = image.select('QA_PIXEL'); const cloudBit = 3; const shadowBit = 4; const cloud = qa.bitwiseAnd(Math.pow(2, cloudBit)).neq(0); const shadow = qa.bitwiseAnd(Math.pow(2, shadowBit)).neq(0); const cloudMask = cloud.or(shadow); const totalPixels = qa.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: lagoHermoso, scale: 30, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('QA_PIXEL'); const cloudPixels = cloudMask.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: lagoHermoso, scale: 30, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('QA_PIXEL'); return ee.Dictionary({ totalPixels: totalPixels, cloudPixels: cloudPixels }); }; // Get first image from each collection const img1 = ee.Image(col1.first()); const img2 = ee.Image(col2.first()); const stats1 = getCloudPercentage(img1).getInfo(); const stats2 = getCloudPercentage(img2).getInfo(); console.log(`Stats1 Total: ${stats1.totalPixels}, Cloud: ${stats1.cloudPixels}`); console.log(`Stats2 Total: ${stats2.totalPixels}, Cloud: ${stats2.cloudPixels}`); if (stats1.totalPixels === null || stats2.totalPixels === null || stats1.cloudPixels === null || stats2.cloudPixels === null) { console.log("Calculation Failure: Null pixel counts"); console.log("C3"); return; } if (stats1.totalPixels === 0 || stats2.totalPixels === 0) { console.log("No Valid Pixels"); console.log("C2"); return; } const cloudPct1 = (stats1.cloudPixels / stats1.totalPixels) * 100; const cloudPct2 = (stats2.cloudPixels / stats2.totalPixels) * 100; console.log(`1987-03-29 Cloud Cover: ${cloudPct1.toFixed(2)}%`); console.log(`2001-02-15 Cloud Cover: ${cloudPct2.toFixed(2)}%`); if (cloudPct1 > cloudPct2) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
